risk.summary: Crisis VIX (403.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 20 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for FAST.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross confluence (EMA 20/50 and SMA 20/50) with ADX trending and Supertrend bullish provides technical structure for continuation, and fear-zone market sentiment offers contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI-9 at 83.94, Stoch at 82.73), weak volume conviction (0.58 ratio), price below Hull MA and Ichimoku cloud, high earnings risk within 14 days, crisis VIX backdrop, and zero fundamental/smart money support create unacceptable pullback risk.
